content: Linguistic annotation was added automatically using the ParZu dependency parser for German BIBREF19 (for tokens and dependency parses), the NLTK toolkit BIBREF20 (for sentences), the TreeTagger BIBREF21 (for part-of-speech tags and lemmas), and Zmorge BIBREF22 (for morphological units). Figure FIGREF34 shows a sample corpus annotation. Together, the metadata shown in Figure FIGREF11 and the annotations presented in Figure FIGREF34 constitute a complete TCF file.
